C0604.title: Earn 300 Yuan a Day for Transferring Money? Six Members of a Money Laundering Ring Sentenced
C0604.summary: The Tong'an Court concluded a case of concealing and disguising criminal proceeds involving a typical 'water room' operation dedicated to splitting and transferring telecom fraud proceeds for laundering. The group members participated in money laundering by transferring funds for others and earned commissions. The case reveals the operational model of 'water rooms' as a critical link in the fraud
